contract: Registration versions 0-4 admit only the fields that version can express: migration at v1, log directories at v2, previous broker epoch at v3. v4 uses that same field set.

The first registration receives epoch 0. A live different incarnation without that epoch is duplicate. A matching previous epoch or a fenced session can be replaced, and the old epoch then fails writes and controller mutations.
A stale heartbeat returns STALE_BROKER_EPOCH and does not refresh the live session. Silence past the session timeout fences the broker.
Confirmed records survive reopen. A failed journal append poisons the handle.
limits: This is not the flexible BrokerRegistration or BrokerHeartbeat RPC and it is not wired into the broker listener.
Heartbeat v2 and the 4.3.1 registration schema hash are not implemented. is_caught_up is always false.
The journal format is the local PLBREG01 record, not an Apache __cluster_metadata log.
Not a production qualification, not native KRaft compatibility, and not a fastest-server claim.
